title: MCP server applies a per-tool token-bucket rate limit to all 30 tools
timestampNote: Historical measuredAt values in this file were written in local time (UTC+1) with a Z suffix; host governance logs use UTC. The 2026-10-21 corrections use actual UTC. Results are unaffected.

environment.workingTree: changes uncommitted; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy performed

before.claim: C02: no MCP tool had a frequency limit.
before.implementation: packages/mcp-server/src/server.ts registered 30 tools with no shared call accounting; a client could call any tool as fast as it could write stdio messages.
before.consequence: A looping or compromised agent could starve the server and repeatedly execute governance mutations.

implementation: packages/mcp-server/src/rate-limit.ts: ToolRateLimiter (per-tool token bucket), rateLimitConfigFromEnv, withRateLimit
packages/mcp-server/src/server.ts: every server.registerTool call is wrapped once at the registration boundary, so all 30 tools and future tools inherit the limit

environment.BEHAVIOROS_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED: 'true' disables the limiter; intended only for trusted local automation

after.throttledResult: MCP result with isError: true and text 'Rate limit exceeded for <tool>: retry after <n> ms (limit <max> calls per <window> ms)'. The handler is not invoked.
after.invalidConfig: Malformed numeric values fall back to the secure default and emit a warning on stderr; they never disable the limiter.

unitCases: capacity consumed then retry delay reported
tokens refill over time instead of a fixed window
one bucket per tool (no cross-tool starvation)
defaults, valid overrides, malformed env values
wrapper does not invoke the callback after the bucket is empty
regressionProof.runtimeCase: The test sets BEHAVIOROS_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=2 before importing the real server, calls bos_get_state over InMemoryTransport twice successfully, and asserts the third call is an MCP error containing 'Rate limit exceeded for bos_get_state'.
regressionProof.structuralCoverage: The limiter is installed by overriding the instance's registerTool method before the 30 registrations, so no tool bypasses it; the existing structural test still counts exactly 30 tools.

smoke.result: 30 tools + 2 resources in a fresh stdio process; governance escalation still produced

realAudit.command: node <temp script> importing packages/core/dist/index.js -> new BehaviorOS().runAudit({simulate:false})
realAudit.result: overall pass; 4/4 stages passed (lint, typecheck, security, coverage), 0 failed, 0 skipped; coverage report coverage/index.html

hostAudit.note: The long-lived host's in-process audit returned fail, while a fresh import of the rebuilt packages/core/dist passes 4/4. The host process predates the rebuild; restart it before trusting its audit result. The exact stale component was not instrumented.

hashNote: Hashes are the C02 measurement snapshot. README.md was corrected later; see corrections[0].hashAfterCorrection. The source/test hashes still match the working tree.
limitations: The limiter is per process and per tool. It is not a distributed quota; stdio MCP has one server process per client.
It throttles runaway behavior but is not authentication or authorization and does not replace the DNA governance rules.
The token buckets are in memory and reset on restart.
BEHAVIOROS_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED=true removes the protection; it is documented for trusted local automation only.
The default 300 calls/60 s per tool is a safety default, not a capacity-tested production SLO.
Docker is not installed in this environment, so the container image was not built or run.
Release automation remains human-gated and unverified; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy was performed.

corrections.change: The CLI table still said `behavioros agent` only shows how to register agents; it now reads registered agents from the SQLite registry.

governanceDeviation.summary: The C02 implementation files were edited before a mission existed for the change. The mission and this evidence were created afterwards; the pre-action gate cannot be reconstructed, so this is recorded as a process deviation, not as a passed gate.
governanceDeviation.preventiveAction: Before the first mutating edit, create and start the mission, run bos_preflight for the intended action, and record the mission id in the change evidence. The plugin auto-creates a mission from prompt intent, but that alone does not prove a pre-action gate ran.
governanceDeviation.status: recorded; the deviation remains a historical limitation
